snippet.title: A Wind-Shaped Love // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/5048520/A_WindShaped_Love

In a world ravaged by disasters, a young rescuer meets an android girl who feels too deeply—and falls in love. When fate tears them apart, he spends ten years chasing a ghost in white. Can love outlast even death?

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: Time
📚 Publisher: Time
📅 Release Date: Coming Soon
🎯 Genre: Adventure, Casual, RPG, Free To Play, Visual Novel

*English language not supported
